_patterns.replacement: 恢复 {1} 的本地备份？这将替换已保存的数据并关闭打开的资源编辑器，恢复前会保留当前数据的备份。

_patterns.pattern:
^([\s\S]*?)

External edit sessions will close\. Stable pending saves are uploaded only when safe; unsent edits are retained in private local folders\.$
_patterns.replacement:
{1}

外部编辑会话将关闭。仅在安全时上传已稳定的待保存内容，未发送的编辑会保留在私有本地文件夹中。

_patterns.replacement: {1}。请检查目标是否已有部分更改，再次选择“以 sudo”进行认证。此任务不会自动重试。

_patterns.pattern: ^Proxies were imported, but migration metadata could not be saved: ([\s\S]*?)\. Original metadata is preserved; refresh to retry\.$
_patterns.replacement: 代理已导入，但无法保存迁移元数据：{1}。已保留原元数据，请刷新后重试。

_patterns.pattern: ^Workspace references were updated, but deletion cleanup could not be acknowledged: ([\s\S]*?)\. Refresh to retry\.$
_patterns.replacement: 工作区引用已更新，但无法确认删除清理完成：{1}。请刷新后重试。

_patterns.pattern: ^([\s\S]*?) active port forward\(s\) will stop\. Running terminal sessions and SFTP work will also be disconnected\.$
